tasks.contract: dispatch_manifest(deliveries, rates) returns a JSON-compatible list ordered by delivery_id. Each result has exactly delivery_id, zone, weight, rate, and cost; rate is selected by zone and cost is weight multiplied by rate. Inputs remain unchanged, and a missing zone rate raises KeyError. Existing delivery and supported cost behavior remains supported.

check.acceptance: dispatch data and rates are joined into a deterministic manifest
